# ADL Business Consulting, PC

> Bay Area CPA and business consulting firm serving small business owners and individuals in Fremont, California and the surrounding Bay Area.

## About

ADL Business Consulting, PC is a California professional corporation founded by Garrett Loughman, a licensed CPA (California License #150109) with over 15 years of experience in accounting, finance, consulting, finance transformation, and both internal and external audit. Founded in 2026, the firm brings big-firm quality directly to small business owners who deserve it.

## Services

ADL offers three services:

- Tax preparation and return review: business and individual returns, prepared or reviewed personally by a licensed CPA, plus review of returns filed by someone else
- Bookkeeping and cleanup: monthly reconciliation, categorization and financial reporting, plus one-time cleanup for books that have fallen behind
- Business advisory and consulting: entity structure and tax elections, payroll provider selection and California payroll compliance, systems and QuickBooks setup, process improvement, and ongoing planning

Note: entity structure, payroll, technology and process work are still performed. They fall under Business Advisory and Consulting rather than being separate services.

Individual clients are served as well as businesses, primarily for personal tax preparation and return review.

## Credentials

- Garrett Loughman, CPA — California License #150109, licensed since 2013
- MBA
- 15+ years in accounting, finance, consulting, finance transformation, internal and external audit

## Location

Fremont, California. Serving clients remotely and in person across the Bay Area.
